svg.title: Research AI use in separate surveys
svg.desc: Panel A compares two separate Wiley survey items across 2024 and 2025: work AI use 57 to 84 percent and research/publication use 45 to 62 percent. Item-specific response bases are 1,043–4,946 in 2024 and 2,118–2,430 in 2025; these are not matched-person changes. Panel B shows two separate questions among 1,260 voluntary quantitative-social-science respondents surveyed in February–March 2026: prior GenAI research-use experience 81 percent and regular command-line coding-agent use more than once a week 20 percent. Both rates use the full sample, which is not representative. Every panel axis spans 0–100 percent. No cross-survey growth series or causal effect is plotted.
